svg.title: Qwen3-8B ROM — coordinate floorplan snapshot
svg.desc: HISTORICAL GEOMETRY • fit failed • current option-C layout not qualified. Drawn from qwen_o4/floorplan.json, rtl_as_instantiated profile; units and proportions are retained. Orange: weight tiles. Purple: central spine reservations. Green: shoreline service and links. This older profile is not the current four-die product and is not evidence of 1.2 GHz closure. Replace after current tile abstracts, TP-4 inventory, clock insertion and composed route are validated.
